name: My mad masquerade
source:
Your friend's invited you to a party, except you didn't expect that the partygoers would totally become party-goners...including your best friend! It's your goal to survive the night: whether that be the common dangers of being a human, or the even more tenebrous horrors of human interaction.

What will kill you first...?...your ability to survive the wrath of humans and demons, or your ability to hold a decent conversation?

[From [url=https://circvoided.itch.io/my-mad-masquerade]itch.io[/url]]
